title: Time to Buy Apple Ahead of Wednesday Event: Analysts
text:
Time to Buy Apple Ahead of Wednesday Event: Analysts By 0
Apple Inc. (AAPL) pulled back 1.1% on Monday as of 11:28 a.m., as analysts said it was a good opportunity to snap up some shares ahead of the September 12 company event.
"We'd recommend buying shares ahead of the event or on any post-event weakness, as the median absolute and relative stock performance six months following an iPhone launch is 26.5% and 9.9%, respectively," said Katy Huberty, equity analyst at Morgan Stanley Research in a research note published on September 7. "The September iPhone launch has rarely been a short-term catalyst for the stock, as the median absolute and relative (to the S&P) stock performance in the day of the event is -0.6% and -0.5%, respectively."...508 more words left in this article.
